teaser: There is a particular hush that falls over a room right before someone says something true — a held breath, a chair easing back an inch. You know that hush well, because life path 11 and the type ENFJ both live close to it. The 11 picks up what has not been said yet; the ENFJ in you turns and says it aloud, gently, before anyone feels ready to hear it. That is the crossing here: raw perception handed a voice built to use it. It can feel like seeing further than the room can see. It can also feel like catching everyone's unspoken weather and calling it your own.
excerpt: The diner sign out front flickers from OPEN to OPE and back, and neither of you has mentioned it in an hour, though you have both noticed.
